# 安全政策 / Security Policy

维护者 / Maintainer: **M-ing**

私密报告邮箱 / Private reporting email: **[smellrosa@gmail.com](mailto:smellrosa@gmail.com)**

## 支持范围 / Supported versions

安全修复面向[最新稳定版本](https://github.com/vigosss/AutoMouseClicker/releases/latest)。旧版本不提供单独的安全修复维护；使用旧版本的用户应升级。仍然欢迎报告旧版本中的问题，维护者会核对最新版本是否受到影响。

Security fixes target the [latest stable release](https://github.com/vigosss/AutoMouseClicker/releases/latest). Older versions do not receive a separate security-maintenance stream; users should upgrade. Reports about older versions are still welcome so the maintainer can check whether the latest release is affected.

## 私密报告 / Reporting privately

请把可能造成未授权访问、代码执行、敏感信息泄露等安全问题发送到 **smellrosa@gmail.com**，不要在公开 Issue、PR 或评论中披露可利用细节。建议邮件标题为 `[Security] 简短描述`，正文包含：

- 受影响的软件版本、Windows 版本和相关运行环境。
- 问题说明、复现步骤或最小验证样例。
- 可能造成的影响，以及你已经确认的信息。
- 相关截图、日志或代码片段（如有），请先脱敏。

Email potential security issues, such as unauthorized access, code execution or sensitive-data exposure, to **smellrosa@gmail.com**. Keep exploitable details out of public issues, pull requests and comments. Use a subject such as `[Security] Short description` and include:

- Affected application version, Windows version and relevant environment.
- A description, reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept.
- Potential impact and what you have confirmed.
- Relevant screenshots, logs or code snippets, sanitized before sharing.

不要发送密码、访问令牌、私人录制或完整个人数据目录。需要样例时，请使用专门制作的测试数据。

Do not send passwords, access tokens, private recordings or entire personal data folders. Use purpose-made test data for examples.

## 处理与披露 / Handling and disclosure

维护者会尽力确认报告、沟通影响和修复进展，但个人维护项目无法承诺固定响应或修复时限。请在公开漏洞细节前，与维护者沟通披露时间；后续信息可以在同一邮件线程补充。

The maintainer will make a reasonable effort to acknowledge reports and communicate impact and progress. This independently maintained project does not promise a fixed response or resolution time. Please coordinate disclosure timing before publishing vulnerability details, and add follow-up information to the same email thread.

普通故障、界面问题和功能建议请使用 [Issues](https://github.com/vigosss/AutoMouseClicker/issues/new/choose)。社区行为投诉请参阅[行为准则](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)。本政策使用邮箱接收报告，不依赖 GitHub 私密漏洞报告功能是否开启。

Use [Issues](https://github.com/vigosss/AutoMouseClicker/issues/new/choose) for ordinary bugs, UI problems and feature requests. For community conduct concerns, see the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Email is the reporting channel for this policy regardless of whether GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled.
